title: row_index_union_jsonmode
description: Regression: a forEach/forEachOrNull branch INSIDE a unionAll, over a field a sibling repeat forces to raw JSON[] (jsonMode branch), that reads %rowIndex. emitJsonEach gates WITH ORDINALITY on the branch fanout's needsOrd/usesRi, but prepUnion never sets those on union-branch fanouts, so the gate read undefined and minted no ordinal -> %rowIndex was left unbound and the build threw 'referencing a scope with no defined iteration position'. The forEach branch's own per-iteration %rowIndex (resets per branch) must bind to the unnest ordinal. Distinct discriminator column makes every row attributable under the order-independent Set comparison.

tests.title: %rowIndex in a forEach unionAll branch over a repeat-forced field
tests.description: unionAll mixes a repeat branch over `item` (which forces `item` to JSON[]) with a forEach branch over the same `item` that reads %rowIndex. The forEach branch is bridged (jsonMode); its %rowIndex must resolve to the per-element ordinal (0,1,2), not error.
